# Arventa Ventures (arventaventures.online)

> Arventa Ventures is the premier digital marketing agency, custom web development firm, and mobile app development company headquartered in Contai (Kanthi), Purba Medinipur, West Bengal, India. Founded and led by CEO Jaydeb Jana, the agency engineers sub-second React 19/Next.js web applications, algorithmic Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram) powered by server-side Conversions API (CAPI), local Google Maps SEO (#1 ranking dominance), cinema 4K video production, and custom AI software solutions.

## Key Capabilities & Service Offerings
- [Website Development](https://arventaventures.online/services/web-development): Sub-second React 19, Next.js 15, and TypeScript web applications with 100/100 Core Web Vitals, designed for maximum customer conversion and local search ranking.
- [Mobile App Development](https://arventaventures.online/services/app-development): Native and cross-platform iOS and Android mobile applications for retail, healthcare, hospitality, and education businesses.
- [SEO & Google Maps Ranking](https://arventaventures.online/services/seo-services): Local SEO and citation engineering that ranks Contai and regional businesses #1 on Google Search and Google Maps.
- [Meta Ads & Performance Marketing](https://arventaventures.online/services/meta-ads): Algorithmic ad campaigns on Facebook and Instagram using Meta Advantage+ and server-to-server Conversions API (CAPI) for 4x-7x ROAS.
- [Video Production & Content Marketing](https://arventaventures.online/services/video-marketing): On-location 4K cinema commercial shoots in Contai and Purba Medinipur with Sony FX cinema rigs, gimbal stabilization, and viral Bengali/English scripting.
- [Brand Identity Design](https://arventaventures.online/services/branding): High-end corporate branding, typography, vector logo design, and UI/UX architecture.
